title: To designate the building utilized as a United States courthouse located at 150 Reade Circle in Greenville, North Carolina, as the "Randy D. Doub United States Courthouse".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was reported to the House on March 23, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This bill designates the building utilized as a U.S. courthouse located at 150 Reade Circle in Greenville, North Carolina, as the "Randy D. Doub United States Courthouse" during the period in which the building is so utilized.

summary.headline: A 2016 law names the federal courthouse in Greenville, North Carolina, after former judge Randy D. Doub.
summary.what_it_does: The law gives the federal courthouse at 150 Reade Circle in Greenville, North Carolina, the official name "Randy D. Doub United States Courthouse." The name applies only while the building is used as a U.S. courthouse. The law does not change how the court operates or what cases it hears.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect on October 7, 2016, the date it was enacted.
